output:
[B1] < deviceA | 'pressed' : false , ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceA
=> < deviceA | 'pressed' : true , ... > .
[B2] < deviceA | 'pressed' : true , 'key' : OldKey , ... > $ UserX 'setKey' deviceA | (Key)
=> < deviceA | 'pressed' : false , 'key' : Key , ... > $ deviceA 'sendBindKey' cloudA | (Key) .
[B2] < cloudA | deviceA : ('bindKey' : OldBindKey , ...) > $ deviceA 'sendBindKey' cloudA | (Key)
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('bindKey' : Key , ...) > .
[B3] < deviceA | 'pressed' : true , 'key' : Key , ... > $ UserX 'getKey' deviceA
=> < deviceA | 'pressed' : false , 'key' : Key , ... > $ deviceA 'sendKey' UserX | (Key) if Key =/= nils .
[B3] < UserX | 'key' : OldKey , ... > $ deviceA 'sendKey' UserX | (Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > .
[B4] < cloudA | deviceA : ('bindKey' : Key , 'owner' : nils , ...) > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (deviceA ; Key)
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('bindKey' : Key , 'owner' : UserX , ...) > .
[B5] < cloudA | deviceA : ('bindKey' : Key , 'owner' : UserX , ...) > $ UserX 'reset' cloudA | (deviceA ; Key)
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('bindKey' : '' , 'owner' : nils , ...) > .
[B6] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > .
[B7] < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .

< deviceA | ('pressed' : false , 'key' : nils) > < cloudA | (deviceA : ('bindKey' : '' , 'owner' : nils)) > < userA | ('near' : deviceA , 'key' : 'keyA') > < userC | ('near' : nils , 'key' : 'keyC') >

[B1] < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > => ev1(UserX) .
[B2] < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , 'key' : (Key , Rest) , ... > => ev2(UserX, Key) .
[B3] < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > => ev3(UserX) .
[B4] < UserX | 'key' : (Key , Rest) , ... > < deviceA | ... > => ev4(UserX, Key) .
[B5] < UserX | 'key' : (Key , Rest) , ... > < deviceA | ... > => ev5(UserX, Key) .
[B6] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > < deviceA | ... > => ev6(UserX) .
[B7] < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > => ev7(UserX) .

attackerLocal =| < userC | 'near' : deviceA , ... > .
